responsibility: Runtime adapter for the GNU Objective-C runtime ABI used by -fgnu-runtime. It fills an objc_runtime_hooks table with GNU-runtime implementations for class/category/protocol/string metadata construction, selector and class references, method-call lowering, constant-string handling, exception support, and final metadata emission, and it generates the GNU runtime’s module descriptor, selector translation tables, protocol/class structures, and related v1 metadata layout consumed by libobjc.
